# Crux 0.4.0 (build 316)
This is the first update delivered through Crux itself. From now on, new builds arrive here; you won't need to download them from the shared folder.
## Fixed
- **Crux no longer quits after your Mac sleeps.** This happened when the Controls module was on. - **The hub closes when you move away.** It could stay open if it had opened while the pointer was just beside the notch. - **No more "shortcut has been run" notices** each time the hub opens with Focus on. Crux now only runs its Focus shortcut when a Focus turns on, or when you tap a Focus button. - **Volume and brightness pop-ups go away on time,** and hovering near one no longer opens the hub. - **The settings gear no longer covers Media's mute button.**
## Improved
- **Smoother open and close.** The hub drops out of the notch as a narrow column and spreads once it's below the menu bar, then folds back the same way.
Already on build 315? You have all of the above; installing this one confirms updates reach you.
Found something off? Settings ▸ General ▸ Copy Diagnostics, and send it along with what happened.
